qualification: Three short authored FLAC streams contain clean verbatim PCM or sample bytes resembling a metadata block / complete frame with a matching prefix CRC. Every complete authored packet independently decodes to literal PCM before indexing. Before correction both collision streams are refused: false metadata moves the cursor inside PCM; a false frame inflates the sample total from128to192. Clean control is healthy. No pre-fix worker seek failure is claimed because opening fails.

New allocation-free frame_size reads header, constant/verbatim/fixed/LPC subframes, Rice/escaped residual layout, wasted bits and footer padding, then checks CRC at the structural endpoint. The owned index no longer searches arbitrary sample bytes for a boundary. Legacy inserted metadata between actual frames remains supported. PCM reconstruction/value checks stay in decode; the prefix API does not claim full sample validity.

After all three streams match every PCM byte and timestamp in actual play/rewind, second-frame seek and EOF (six worker targets).1460 existing profiles pass exact prefix lengths, concatenated-frame/metadata prefixes, strict decode trailing-data refusal, truncated tails and CRC damage; eight malformed entropy/padding controls also refuse. Player and no-default core configurations pass.

Twelve root integration tests,22 reader units, eight standalone media-library tests including full/interval export, channel layouts, cancellation, packet and controlled-memory limits pass. One legacy corrupted-residual unit expected the old CRC-search wording; its input still refuses, now at structural footer padding with the frame offset. The diagnostic assertion was updated and all22 reader units rerun.

Independent local libFLAC confirms literal PCM for all three full streams. FFmpeg matches clean/metadata cases but has its own false-frame collision failure; this limitation is retained in the reference artifact and counts zero. Normal tests and generation require neither external decoder, network nor private media.

The naive structural parser was replaced after a slow pilot. Seven alternating pairs show optimized/naive median0.269795 with identical indexed counters. Against the original index, two15-pair runs (10000/20000 iterations per run, four existing synthetic clips) give median ratios1.001952and1.008387; confirmation median bootstrap95 interval1.005695..1.011992. This is a correctness fix with about1percent typical measured overhead, not a speedup. All outliers are retained; concurrent workspace load is not isolated and tail latency / long-file performance is not qualified.

Public frame_size is an additive API for one frame in a byte prefix. Existing decode still requires exactly one packet. Error messages now identify the frame offset and structural/CRC cause; callers matching the old free-form text must adapt. Documentation describes this distinction. No physical DAC, GPU or full external-decoder equivalence claim.

sources.rule: The sample count and subframe syntax determine the payload extent. Sync-like sample data and prefix CRC matches do not establish a frame boundary.

compatibility: Valid collision streams now open and play. Legacy metadata insertion and strict full-packet decode remain supported. New prefix API is additive; free-form error wording becomes more precise.
counting: One ambiguous FLAC boundary defect. Two collision variants, structural API, fast Rice/CRC implementation, benchmark infrastructure and legacy diagnostic update add no extra IDs.
